exact_projection_statement: For a priori SOURCE lex-leading triples lA,lB, leading-H,L and relative-s degree<=2 of a product uses only the same projections of both factors; sums shift relative-s offsets and omit only SOURCE-higherH/L or degree>2 children. Actual cancelled faces never shift the supplied SOURCE leads.
proof: A SOURCE exponent minus its supplied lead is lex-nonnegative in Z^3. In a product that reaches total H-deficit0 both H-deficits are0; then total L-deficit0 forces both L-deficits0; remaining s-deficits are nonnegative and sum<=2. Addition/copy follow the same fixed coordinates. q,t remain untouched.
